e.title: ClaimLens：三道具名弃权闸门、明文评级公式与 CBUAE 条款引用——把机器学习严格限制在「看见」这一层
e.title_en: ClaimLens: three named abstention gates, an explicit rating formula and cited CBUAE clauses — confining machine learning strictly to the perception layer
e.title_hk: ClaimLens：三道具名棄權閘門、明文評級公式與 CBUAE 條款引用——把機器學習嚴格限制在「看見」這一層
e.summary: 一个可解释的车损与全损分诊系统：两级微调 YOLOv8-seg 分别识别 21 类车身部件与 6 类碰撞损伤，用 Shapely 多边形相交把损伤映射到部件并判断是否触及承载结构，再以爬取到的阿联酋原厂配件价（AED）走确定性成本引擎，按 CBUAE 保单条款做全损判定；它在图像质量、结构完整性、置信下限三处都设有具名弃权状态，并输出一份「哪些还不知道」清单
e.summary_hk: 一個可解釋的車損與全損分診系統：兩級微調 YOLOv8-seg 分別識別 21 類車身部件與 6 類碰撞損傷，用 Shapely 多邊形相交把損傷映射到部件並判斷是否觸及承載結構，再以爬取到的阿聯酋原廠配件價（AED）走確定性成本引擎，按 CBUAE 保單條款做全損判定；它在圖像質量、結構完整性、置信下限三處都設有具名棄權狀態，並輸出一份「哪些還不知道」清單
e.summary_en: An explainable vehicle damage and total-loss triage system: two fine-tuned YOLOv8-seg networks identify 21 body components and 6 collision damage classes respectively, Shapely polygon intersection maps damage onto components and determines whether load-bearing structure is touched, and a deterministic costing engine priced in AED from scraped UAE OEM parts data feeds a CBUAE-clause-based total-loss test; it has named abstention states at three separate points — image quality, structural integrity and a confidence floor — and emits an explicit "what is not known" checklist
e.body:
**ClaimLens** 是一个**可解释的车损与全损分诊系统**（仓库 `Chirudeva-Reddy/ClaimLens`），**实测 MIT 许可（`LICENSE` 于 main 分支实测 200）、★0、fork 0、主语言 Python、仓库体量 14,746 KB、创建于 2026-09-07、最后推送 2026-09-09**（**均 GitHub API 实测值，在解冻窗口内**）；**实测 topics 8 项**：**`computer-vision`、`explainable-ai`、`fastapi`、`instance-segmentation`、`insurtech`、`python`、`pytorch`、`yolov8`**；**README 实测 12,152 字节**；**另有实测在线演示 `chirudeva-reddy.github.io/ClaimLens/`**。**已实测存在的关键文件**：**`app.py`、`claimlens/api.py`、`data/price_table.json`、`scripts/scrape_uae_oem_parts.py`、`LICENSE`**。本条目属于本轮主题**「分开『我看到了什么』与『我因此断定什么』」**中的**第一种，也是把这条界线划得最硬的一种**。

可核实信息（**均 README 逐字实测**）：**标题与定位逐字为**：**「An explainable, two-stage vehicle damage and total-loss triage system. **Option C Architecture: Two-Stage Computer Vision + Spatial Overlap + Scraped UAE OEM Parts Pricing (AED) + CBUAE Policy Retrieval + Safe Abstention.**」**。⭐⭐⭐ **其问题陈述逐字，是本条目最值得先记的一段**：**「A common pitfall in modern AI applications is treating total-loss assessment as a **naive end-to-end black-box classifier** or **querying generic Large Language Models as pricing oracles**. In practice, this leads to **dangerous failure modes**: **hallucinations of repair costs, ignoring unibody structural compromises, and issuing high-confidence predictions on ambiguous evidence**.」**——**即三个具名的失效模式：**捏造维修成本、忽略承载式车身结构受损、以及在证据模棱两可时给出高置信预测****。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「把机器学习严格限制在它能做好的事上，成本、全损阈值与法律引用一律用纯确定性规则」是本条目最重要的一句，也是本轮主题最干脆的表述**——**逐字为**：**「ClaimLens **restricts ML strictly to what vision models excel at (segmentation and localization)** and uses **pure deterministic rules for costing, total-loss thresholds, and legal citations**.」**⭐⭐ **这与本站连续多轮出现的同一判断接上了谱系**：**第 329 轮 [[insurance-tabular-review]] 按列型切分、同轮 [[reinsurance-treaty-agent]] 正则优先、第 330 轮 [[actuary-os]] 按架构切分、第 331 轮 [[claim-ops]] 写成偏好序＋禁止清单、第 332 轮 [[paco-uw]] 把规则做成纯数据、第 332 轮 [[guidewire-claim-intelligence]] 把理算人路由留给规则引擎**；**本条的特点是把界线**写在了架构名里**（「Option C」）**且给出了**三条具体的 LLM 反模式**作为理由**（见 ② ）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **「Why Not Just Ask an LLM?」一节逐字列出三条理由，是本会话见到对**为什么不能用多模态大模型做定价**最完整的论证**：**① **Unconstrained Pricing Hallucination**——「LLMs hallucinate part prices, **blending global and local currency rates with no knowledge of UAE parts availability or bodyshop labor guides**」**；**② **Failure to Abstain**——「**LLMs are trained to be helpful and almost always force an estimate, even when critical structural rails or suspension components are hidden from view**」**；**③ **Legal Non-Compliance**——「Insurance payouts require **itemized, auditable line items cited against statutory regulations** (e.g. CBUAE Schedule 2 depreciation scales), **not unstructured conversational summaries**」**。⭐⭐⭐ **第 ② 条尤其值得记住**：**「模型被训练成乐于助人，因此几乎总会强行给出一个估计」**——**这正是「不肯只给一个数」（第 332 轮主题）在**模型行为层面**的根源**（**可与第 329 轮 [[reinsurance-treaty-agent]] 的 flagging-not-blocking、第 331 轮 [[aida-tix-anomaly-detection]] 的「分数没有解释就不可执行」并读**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **三道各自具名的弃权闸门是本条目在安全设计上最值得记的一处**——**架构逐字为**：**① 图像质量闸门**（模糊／低分辨率 → **弃权：质量闸门拒绝**）；**② 承载结构判定**（损伤触及 `quarter-panel`／`rocker-panel`／`roof`／立柱 → **安全弃权：结构完整性必须人工检查**）；**③ 校准置信下限 30%**（低于下限 → **安全弃权：证据模棱两可**）。⭐⭐ **三条闸门分别对应**输入不可用、标的超出视觉可判范围、以及模型自身不确定**三类不同成因**——**而不是笼统地「低于阈值就转人工」**；**且三条都终止于同一个具名状态**：**`INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE_INSPECTION_REQUIRED`**。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **弃权时输出的「What Isn’t Known」清单是本条目最有教育价值的一处**——**逐字为**：**「ClaimLens abstains (`INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE_INSPECTION_REQUIRED`) and outputs an explicit **"What Isn’t Known"** checklist (**laser bench alignment, ADAS calibration, SRS airbag sensors, steering geometry**).」**——**即它不只说「我不知道」，而列出**照片在原理上无法确立的四项**（激光台架校准、ADAS 标定、SRS 气囊传感器、转向几何）**；⭐⭐ **对做核保或理赔设计的学生，这是一份**「照片能证明什么、不能证明什么」的边界清单**——**而这四项恰好都是**现代车辆上「看不见但决定安全性」的部件****（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**该清单完整或适用于任何辖区的实际检验要求**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **全损阈值把四个辖区并排列出，是本条目对做跨市场定价的学生最实用的一处**——**逐字为**：**「UAE Unified Motor Policy: **50%** statutory economic constructive total loss threshold. **US Total Loss Formula (TLF): 70% / 75% thresholds.** **UK / European Market Reference: 60% threshold.** **Custom Threshold: User-configurable ratio slider (10%–100%).」**，**其公式逐字为**：**「Economic Loss Ratio = Estimated Visible Repair Cost (AED) / Pre-Accident Vehicle Cash Value (AED)」**⭐⭐⭐ **同一个「经济性全损」概念在三个市场对应三个不同阈值（阿联酋 50%、美国 70%／75%、英国／欧洲 60%），并附一个可调滑块**——**这是**保险监管跨辖区差异**的一个具体而少见的对照**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**这些阈值的最新或完整**——**本次未查阅任何监管原文**；**⚠️ 亦未核实英国／欧洲是否确以 60% 为准**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐⭐ **成本引擎「不捏造价格」的做法逐字实测，且是主题的又一处落点**——**逐字为**：**「ClaimLens **does not** hallucinate costs. Its pricing engine is powered by an automated crawler (`scripts/scrape_uae_oem_parts.py`) that extracted **3,174 live automotive body components across 6,712 catalog items from UAE suppliers**. Users can select their vehicle make (**Toyota, Nissan, Hyundai, Ford, Lexus, Mercedes-Benz, General Market Standard**), applying brand-accurate OEM part costs and standard UAE bodyshop labor rates.」**⭐⭐ **即**价格来自爬取的真实目录，而非模型生成**；**⚠️ 本词条**必须同时记两点**：**① 该爬虫本次**未运行、未核实**其抓取是否获得目标站点许可或符合其条款**；**② 价格数据会随时间失效**（**本次未核实其数据的时点**）。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **法定条款检索逐字实测，且给出了具体条款号**——**其引擎为 TF-IDF 余弦相似度**，**查询 **CBUAE 统一机动车保险单**（逐字称为「the mandatory statutory baseline applied by **Sukoon, Orient, ADNIC, and all UAE motor insurers**」）的条款**：**Article 7(2)（维修成本超过市价 50% 构成推定全损）、Article 7(3)（车架变形的结构适航与全损规则）、Schedule 2（法定配件折旧表与认证更换标准）**；**并以「**Not Established**」为严格回退阈值（0.12）**——⭐ **即检索不到就明说检索不到，而不是给出最相近的一条**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**其条款引用准确或及时**——**本次未查阅 CBUAE 原文**）。**⑧ ⭐⭐⭐ **其评测表（Blueprint §11）含一行「安全不变量」，是本条目最值得引用的一处**——**逐字为**：**「**Safety Invariant** | **False High-Confidence Rate** | **0.0%** | **Zero automated decisions on ambiguous, low-confidence, or structural evidence.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **把**「高置信度错误率」**单列为一个不变量并给出 0.0% 的目标**，**等于把**「不许在不确定时自信」**写成了可测指标**；**同表的其余行逐字另有**：**图像质量闸门可用图查准／查全 **96.7%／98.2%**（方差-拉普拉斯模糊判据 var ≥ 15.0 与 480×480 分辨率下限）**；**部件模型 Box／Mask mAP@50 **82.0%／80.8%**（21 类、998 张图、**Humans in the Loop CC0 数据集**、Apple Silicon MPS）**；**损伤模型 **64.6%／63.6%**（6 类、2,850 张 **CarDD** 图）**；**空间相交面板匹配准确率 **94.2%**；**成本估算中位绝对百分比误差 **4.8%**（对照人工审核的阿联酋认证维修估价）**；**全损分诊灵敏度／特异度 **95.0%／92.3%**（在决策边界样本上对照 CBUAE 50% 与美国 70%／75% 阈值）**；**校准 Brier 分数／下限 **0.082／30%**；**条款检索正确率 **91.7%****（**⚠️ 全部为 README 自述，本次未运行**）。**⑨ ⭐⭐ **在线演示的能力边界被逐字写清，是一处少见的诚实**——**逐字为**：**「GitHub Pages serves files, so the segmentation models **cannot run there**: the three validation scenarios **replay responses frozen from a real pipeline run**, and the total-loss recalculation is mirrored in the browser.」**，**并逐字分列**：**演示中可用**（三个情景及其分割叠加与明细行、实时 ACV 与阈值模拟、辖区预设、理算报告与 JSON 导出）**；**需要推理故在演示中禁用**（上传自己的照片、切换原厂价格档）；**并指明「Run it locally for those.」**⭐⭐ **即它明确区分**「部署出来能看什么」与「必须本地才能跑什么」****。**⑩ ⭐⚠️ **一处可核实的前后不一致**：**README 顶部徽章逐字为「tests **52 passed**」，而同文 Quickstart 的注释逐字为「Run the complete test suite (**44 tests**)」**——**两处对测试数量的说法不同**；**本词条如实记录该不一致，并不主张哪一个正确**（**本次未运行 pytest**）。**⑪ ⭐⭐ **路线图逐字含未完成项**：**Phase 0–2（图像质量闸门、**0 分割泄漏**的数据准备）、Phase 3（Option C 两级 YOLOv8-seg 与 MPS 加速）、Phase 4（AED 确定性维修成本引擎）、Phase 5（CBUAE 50% 经济规则的全损决策引擎）、Phase 6（法定条款检索）、Phase 7（带空间叠加与推理轨迹的 FastAPI 驾驶舱）、爬虫流水线、Phase 8（模型卡与 Blueprint §11 评测表）均已勾选**；**而 **[ ] Phase 9 Deployment（Hugging Face Spaces 与 GitHub 公开部署）** 与 **[ ] Future / Extension（多图 360° 车辆检查融合；次级仪表板警示灯诊断）** **未勾选****——⭐ **注意：Phase 9 未完成与其在线演示并不矛盾**（**演示是 GitHub Pages 的冻结回放，而 Phase 9 指的是带推理的部署**）。**⑫ ⭐ **免责声明逐字**：**「ClaimLens is an **educational and portfolio demonstration system**. All repair estimates, pricing tiers, and policy citations are **illustrative and do not constitute binding insurance underwriting, claim adjusting, mechanical engineering, or legal advice**. **Certified physical inspection by a licensed collision repair adjuster is mandatory for all roadworthiness determinations.**」**。**⑬ ⭐ 可与本站车损与理赔条目并读**：[[car-damage-assessment-ai]]、[[yolo11m-car-damage-detector]]、[[claims-intake-agent]]、[[claims-triage-risk-scoring-agent]]、[[digital-claims-management]]、[[insurance-conformal-fraud]]、[[credit-risk]]、[[insurance-governance]]、[[condition-parametric-zk]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实的是**仓库元数据、topics（8 项）、README（12,152 字节）全文的定位段、问题陈述、架构图、六个模块、Blueprint §11 评测表、「Why Not Just Ask an LLM?」三节、演示能力分列、Quickstart、路线图与免责声明**，**并以 raw 探测确认 `app.py`、`claimlens/api.py`、`data/price_table.json`、`scripts/scrape_uae_oem_parts.py` 与 `LICENSE` 均存在（HTTP 200）**，⭐⭐ **但**未克隆、未安装、未运行其 FastAPI 应用或 pytest、未下载任何模型权重、未访问其在线演示、未读 `claimlens/` 下任何源码、未打开 `data/price_table.json`、未运行其爬虫、未读 `tests/`****，因此**不能转述其模型训练细节、特征工程、空间相交实现、成本引擎规则、条款检索索引或任何实际输出**；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **未核实**其评测表中**全部数值**（可用图 96.7%／98.2%、部件 82.0%／80.8%、损伤 64.6%／63.6%、面板匹配 94.2%、成本误差 4.8%、分诊 95.0%／92.3%、Brier 0.082、条款检索 91.7%）**——**本次完全未运行**；**本词条只记录其**自述数值**，**不主张**任何一项正确**；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **未核实**「安全不变量：高置信度错误率 0.0%」**——**这是一条**极强的主张****（**声称从未在模棱两可、低置信或结构受损证据上作出自动决定**）；**其成立与否取决于**三条闸门的实现与测试覆盖**；**这是本条目最需要后续核实的一处**，**本词条**不主张**该不变量已成立**；**④ ⭐⭐ **未核实**其爬取的 3,174 项原厂部件与 6,712 条目录是否真实、是否现行、以及**其爬取行为是否获得目标站点许可或符合其服务条款****（**本次未运行爬虫、未查看任何供应商站点**）；**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**其价格数据的使用在法律或合同上无风险**；**⑤ ⭐⭐ **未核实**其援引的 CBUAE 条款号（Article 7(2)、7(3)、Schedule 2）是否准确、是否为现行版本**——**本次未查阅 CBUAE 原文**；**本词条**不主张**其条款引用可用于任何真实理赔或法律用途**；**⑥ ⭐⭐ **未核实**其「UAE 50%／US 70%–75%／UK-EU 60%」三个全损阈值的准确性**（**⚠️ 尤其英国／欧洲的 60% 本次未获任何独立来源支持**）；**本词条**不主张**该跨辖区对照可用于实际判**；**⑦ ⭐ **未核实**「Sukoon、Orient、ADNIC 及所有阿联酋车险公司均适用该保单」这一表述**；**⑧ ⭐ **未核实**其「0 分割泄漏」的数据准备主张**；**⑨ ⭐ ⚠️ **本词条**不主张**其与任何监管机构（含 CBUAE）存在认可、认证或背书关系**——**README 的「CBUAE Compliant」徽章为**其自述****；**本次未核实任何此类关系**；**⑩ ⭐ ⚠️ 车辆**全损判定**在多数辖区属**受监管的保险理赔与机械安全判断****；**本项目自述为教育与作品集演示**，**并明确要求所有适航判定必须由持牌碰撞维修理算师现场检验**；**本词条据此**不主张**其可用于任何真实的理赔决定、全损判定、适航判断或法律用途**；**⑪ ⭐ ★0、fork 0**，**关注度极低**（**尽管其工程完整度与文档量远超同类★0项目**），**不主张其成熟度、正确性或已被采用**；**⑫ ⭐ **其 topics 含 `insurtech` 与 `explainable-ai`**，**与 GitHub 的实际分类一致**；**⑬ 是否有中文材料本次未核实**（**README 实测为英文**）。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/Chirudeva-Reddy/ClaimLens` 于 2026-09-11 经 GitHub API 实测读取（含许可、★数、语言、体量、创建／推送时间与 8 项 topics）；README 12,152 字节经 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 实测逐字核对；**`app.py`、`claimlens/api.py`、`data/price_table.json`、`scripts/scrape_uae_oem_parts.py`、`LICENSE` 经 raw 探测确认存在（HTTP 200）**；**未克隆、未安装、未运行、未访问演示、未读源码**。

**ClaimLens** 是一個**可解釋的車損與全損分診系統**（倉庫 `Chirudeva-Reddy/ClaimLens`），**實測 MIT 許可（`LICENSE` 於 main 分支實測 200）、★0、fork 0、主語言 Python、體量 14,746 KB、創建於 2026-09-07、最後推送 2026-09-09**（**在解凍窗口內**）；**實測 topics 8 項**：**`computer-vision`、`explainable-ai`、`fastapi`、`instance-segmentation`、`insurtech`、`python`、`pytorch`、`yolov8`**；**README 實測 12,152 位元組**；**另有實測線上演示 `chirudeva-reddy.github.io/ClaimLens/`**。**已實測存在的關鍵檔案**：**`app.py`、`claimlens/api.py`、`data/price_table.json`、`scripts/scrape_uae_oem_parts.py`、`LICENSE`**。本條目屬本輪主題**「分開『我看到了什麼』與『我因此斷定什麼』」**中的**第一種，也是把這條界線劃得最硬的一種**。

可核實資訊（**均 README 逐字實測**）：**標題與定位逐字**：**「An explainable, two-stage vehicle damage and total-loss triage system. **Option C Architecture: Two-Stage Computer Vision + Spatial Overlap + Scraped UAE OEM Parts Pricing (AED) + CBUAE Policy Retrieval + Safe Abstention.**」**。⭐⭐⭐ **問題陳述逐字**：**「A common pitfall in modern AI applications is treating total-loss assessment as a **naive end-to-end black-box classifier** or **querying generic Large Language Models as pricing oracles**. In practice, this leads to **dangerous failure modes**: **hallucinations of repair costs, ignoring unibody structural compromises, and issuing high-confidence predictions on ambiguous evidence**.」**——**即三個具名的失效模式：**捏造維修成本、忽略承載式車身結構受損、以及在證據模稜兩可時給出高置信預測****。

對 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「把機器學習嚴格限制在它能做好的事上，成本、全損閾值與法律引用一律用純確定性規則」是最重要的一句，也是本輪主題最乾脆的表述**——**逐字「ClaimLens **restricts ML strictly to what vision models excel at (segmentation and localization)** and uses **pure deterministic rules for costing, total-loss thresholds, and legal citations**.」**⭐⭐ **與本站連續多輪同一判斷接上譜系**（**329 [[insurance-tabular-review]] 按列型、同輪 [[reinsurance-treaty-agent]] 正則優先、330 [[actuary-os]] 按架構、331 [[claim-ops]] 偏好序＋禁止清單、332 [[paco-uw]] 規則即資料、332 [[guidewire-claim-intelligence]] 理算人路由留給規則引擎**）；**本條的特點是把界線**寫進了架構名**（「Option C」）**並給出三條具體的 LLM 反模式作為理由**。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **「Why Not Just Ask an LLM?」三條理由逐字，是本會話見到對**為何不能用多模態大模型做定價**最完整的論證**：① **Unconstrained Pricing Hallucination**——「LLMs hallucinate part prices, **blending global and local currency rates with no knowledge of UAE parts availability or bodyshop labor guides**」；② **Failure to Abstain**——「**LLMs are trained to be helpful and almost always force an estimate, even when critical structural rails or suspension components are hidden from view**」；③ **Legal Non-Compliance**——「Insurance payouts require **itemized, auditable line items cited against statutory regulations** (e.g. CBUAE Schedule 2 depreciation scales), **not unstructured conversational summaries**」**⭐⭐⭐ **第 ② 條尤其值得記住**：**「模型被訓練成樂於助人，因此幾乎總會強行給出一個估計」**——**這正是「不肯只給一個數」（第 332 輪主題）在**模型行為層面**的根源**。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **三道各自具名的棄權閘門是安全設計上最值得記的一處**：①**圖像質量閘門**（模糊／低解析度 → **棄權：質量閘門拒絕**）；②**承載結構判定**（損傷觸及 `quarter-panel`／`rocker-panel`／`roof`／立柱 → **安全棄權：結構完整性必須人工檢查**）；③**校準置信下限 30%**（低於下限 → **安全棄權：證據模稜兩可**）**——**三條閘門分別對應**輸入不可用、標的超出視覺可判範圍、模型自身不確定**三類不同成因**，**且都終止於同一具名狀態 `INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE_INSPECTION_REQUIRED`**。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **棄權時輸出的「What Isn’t Known」清單最有教育價值**——**逐字「…outputs an explicit **"What Isn’t Known"** checklist (**laser bench alignment, ADAS calibration, SRS airbag sensors, steering geometry**).」**——**不只說「我不知道」，而列出**照片在原理上無法確立的四項****（**⚠️ 不主張**該清單完整或適用於任何轄區的實際檢驗要求**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **全損閾值把四個轄區並排列出，對做跨市場定價的學生最實用**——**逐字「UAE Unified Motor Policy: **50%** … **US Total Loss Formula (TLF): 70% / 75% thresholds.** **UK / European Market Reference: 60% threshold.** **Custom Threshold: User-configurable ratio slider (10%–100%).」**，**公式逐字「Economic Loss Ratio = Estimated Visible Repair Cost (AED) / Pre-Accident Vehicle Cash Value (AED)」**⭐⭐⭐ **同一「經濟性全損」概念在三個市場對應三個不同閾值並附可調滑塊**（**⚠️ 不主張**這些閾值最新或完整——**未查閱任何監管原文**；**⚠️ 亦未核實英國／歐洲是否確以 60% 為準**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐⭐ ADNIC, and all UAE motor insurers**」）的 **Article 7(2)、Article 7(3)、Schedule 2**；**並以「**Not Established**」為嚴格回退閾值（0.12）**——⭐ **即檢索不到就明說檢索不到**（**⚠️ 不主張**其條款引用準確或及時**）。**⑧ ⭐⭐⭐ **評測表含一行「安全不變量」**——**逐字「**Safety Invariant** | **False High-Confidence Rate** | **0.0%** | **Zero automated decisions on ambiguous, low-confidence, or structural evidence.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **把**「高置信度錯誤率」**單列為不變量並給出 0.0% 目標**；**同表其餘逐字另有**：圖像質量閘門 96.7%／98.2%（方差-拉普拉斯模糊判據 var ≥ 15.0 與 480×480 下限）；部件模型 82.0%／80.8%（21 類、998 張、**Humans in the Loop CC0**）；損傷模型 64.6%／63.6%（6 類、2,850 張 there**: the three validation scenarios **replay responses frozen from a real pipeline run**…」**，**並分列演示中可用（三情景、分割疊加、ACV 與閾值模擬、轄區預設、理算報告、JSON 匯出）與因需推理而禁用（上傳自己照片、切換原廠價格檔），並指明「Run it locally for system**」與「**Certified physical inspection by a licensed collision repair adjuster is mandatory for all roadworthiness determinations.**」。**⑬ ⭐ 可與 [[car-damage-assessment-ai]]、[[yolo11m-car-damage-detector]]、[[claims-intake-agent]]、[[claims-triage-risk-scoring-agent]]、[[digital-claims-management]]、[[insurance-conformal-fraud]]、[[insurance-governance]]、[[condition-parametric-zk]] **ClaimLens** is **an explainable vehicle damage and total-loss triage system** (repository `Chirudeva-Reddy/ClaimLens`), with **measured MIT licence (`LICENSE` measured 200 on main), ★0, 0 forks, Python as the primary language, a 14,746 KB repository, created 2026-09-07 and last pushed 2026-09-09** (**all GitHub API measurements, inside the thaw window**); **eight topics measurably present**: **`computer-vision`, `explainable-ai`, `fastapi`, `instance-segmentation`, `insurtech`, `python`, `pytorch` and `yolov8`**; **the README measures 12,152 bytes**; **and a live demo at `chirudeva-reddy.github.io/ClaimLens/` is measurably present**. **Key files measurably present**: **`app.py`, `claimlens/api.py`, `data/price_table.json`, `scripts/scrape_uae_oem_parts.py` and `LICENSE`**. It is the first of this round’s four takes on **separating "what I observed" from "what I therefore conclude"**, **and the one that draws that line hardest**.

Verifiable details (**all read verbatim from the README**): **the title and positioning read verbatim**: **"An explainable, two-stage vehicle damage and total-loss triage system. Option C Architecture: Two-Stage Computer Vision + Spatial Overlap + Scraped UAE OEM Parts Pricing (AED) + CBUAE Policy Retrieval + Safe Abstention."** ⭐⭐⭐ **Its problem statement, read verbatim, is the passage to record first**: **"A common pitfall in modern AI applications is treating total-loss assessment as a naive end-to-end black-box classifier or querying generic Large Language Models as pricing oracles. In practice, this leads to dangerous failure modes: hallucinations of repair costs, ignoring unibody structural compromises, and issuing high-confidence predictions on ambiguous evidence."** — **three named failure modes: fabricated repair costs, ignored load-bearing structural damage, and high-confidence predictions on ambiguous evidence**.

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐⭐ "ClaimLens restricts ML strictly to what vision models excel at and uses pure deterministic rules for costing, total-loss thresholds, and legal citations" is the entry’s most important sentence and this round’s crispest statement of the theme** — verbatim: **"ClaimLens restricts ML strictly to what vision models excel at (segmentation and localization) and uses pure deterministic rules for costing, total-loss thresholds, and legal citations."** ⭐⭐ **This joins a lineage that recurs across this site**: **column kinds in round 329’s [[insurance-tabular-review]], regex-first in that round’s [[reinsurance-treaty-agent]], architecture in round 330’s [[actuary-os]], a preference ordering plus prohibition list in round 331’s [[claim-ops]], rules as pure data in round 332’s [[paco-uw]], and the rule engine left in charge of adjuster routing in that round’s [[guidewire-claim-intelligence]]**; **what is distinctive here is that the boundary is written into the architecture’s own name ("Option C") and justified by three concrete LLM anti-patterns (see ②)**. **② ⭐⭐⭐ Its "Why Not Just Ask an LLM?" section lists three reasons verbatim, the most complete argument this session has seen for why a multimodal LLM cannot price a claim**: **① Unconstrained Pricing Hallucination** — **"LLMs hallucinate part prices, blending global and local currency rates with no knowledge of UAE parts availability or bodyshop labor guides"**; **② Failure to Abstain** — **"LLMs are trained to be helpful and almost always force an estimate, even when critical structural rails or suspension components are hidden from view"**; **③ Legal Non-Compliance** — **"Insurance payouts require itemized, auditable line items cited against statutory regulations (e.g. CBUAE Schedule 2 depreciation scales), not unstructured conversational summaries"**. ⭐⭐⭐ **Reason ② is worth memorising: "LLMs are trained to be helpful and almost always force an estimate" — this is the root, at the model-behaviour level, of round 332’s theme of refusing to give just one number.** **③ ⭐⭐⭐ Three separately named abstention gates are the entry’s most notable safety design** — **the architecture reads verbatim as**: **① an image-quality gate** (blurry or low-resolution → **abstain: quality gate rejection**); **② a load-bearing structural test** (damage intersecting `quarter-panel`, `rocker-panel`, `roof` or pillars → **safe abstention: structural integrity requires mandatory inspection**); **③ a calibrated confidence floor of 30%** (below the floor → **safe abstention: ambiguous evidence**). ⭐⭐ **The three gates correspond to three distinct causes — unusable input, a subject beyond what vision can decide, and the model’s own uncertainty — rather than a single blanket "below threshold, refer to a human"**, **and all three terminate in the same named state `INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE_INSPECTION_REQUIRED`**. **④ ⭐⭐⭐ The "What Isn’t Known" checklist emitted on abstention is the entry’s most educational detail** — verbatim: **"ClaimLens abstains (`INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE_INSPECTION_REQUIRED`) and outputs an explicit \"What Isn’t Known\" checklist (laser bench alignment, ADAS calibration, SRS airbag sensors, steering geometry)."** — **it does not merely say "I don’t know" but lists four things a photograph cannot in principle establish**; ⭐⭐ **for students designing underwriting or claims flows, that is a boundary list of what a photo can and cannot prove — and all four are invisible modern-vehicle components that determine safety** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim the list is complete or matches any jurisdiction’s actual inspection requirements**). **⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ Listing four jurisdictions’ total-loss thresholds side by side is the entry’s most practical detail for cross-market pricing work** — verbatim: **"UAE Unified Motor Policy: 50% statutory economic constructive total loss threshold. US Total Loss Formula (TLF): 70% / 75% thresholds. UK / European Market Reference: 60% threshold. Custom Threshold: User-configurable ratio slider (10%–100%)."**, **with the formula reading verbatim "Economic Loss Ratio = Estimated Visible Repair Cost (AED) / Pre-Accident Vehicle Cash Value (AED)"**. ⭐⭐⭐ **The same concept of economic total loss maps to three different thresholds in three markets (UAE 50%, US 70%/75%, UK/Europe 60%) plus an adjustable slider** — **a concrete and rarely-seen comparison of cross-jurisdictional regulatory difference** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim these thresholds are current or complete — no regulatory text was consulted; ⚠️ and whether the UK/Europe figure is indeed 60% was not verified**). **⑥ ⭐⭐⭐ The costing engine refusing to fabricate prices reads verbatim and is another landing point for the theme** — verbatim: **"ClaimLens does not hallucinate costs. Its pricing engine is powered by an automated crawler (`scripts/scrape_uae_oem_parts.py`) that extracted 3,174 live automotive body components across 6,712 catalog items from UAE suppliers. Users can select their vehicle make (Toyota, Nissan, Hyundai, Ford, Lexus, Mercedes-Benz, General Market Standard), applying brand-accurate OEM part costs and standard UAE bodyshop labor rates."** ⭐⭐ **⚠️ Two things must be recorded alongside: ① the crawler was not run and whether its scraping was licensed by or compliant with the target sites’ terms was not verified; ② price data goes stale** (**its reference date was not checked**). **⑦ ⭐⭐ Statutory clause retrieval reads verbatim and names specific articles** — **a TF-IDF cosine-similarity engine querying the CBUAE Unified Motor Vehicle Insurance Policy** (called verbatim **"the mandatory statutory baseline applied by Sukoon, Orient, ADNIC, and all UAE motor insurers"**) **for Article 7(2), Article 7(3) and Schedule 2**, **with a strict "Not Established" fallback threshold of 0.12** — ⭐ **retrieval failure is stated rather than answered with the nearest clause** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim the citations are accurate or current — the CBUAE text was not consulted**). **⑧ ⭐⭐⭐ Its evaluation table carries a row for a safety invariant, the entry’s most quotable line** — verbatim: **"Safety Invariant | False High-Confidence Rate | 0.0% | Zero automated decisions on ambiguous, low-confidence, or structural evidence."** ⭐⭐⭐ **Making "false high-confidence rate" a named invariant with a 0.0% target turns "never be confident when unsure" into a measurable criterion**; **the table’s other rows read verbatim as**: **image-quality gate usable-image precision/recall 96.7%/98.2%** (variance-of-Laplacian blur check at var ≥ 15.0 and a 480×480 resolution floor); **parts model 82.0%/80.8%** (21 classes, 998 images, **Humans in the Loop CC0 dataset**, Apple Silicon MPS); **damage model 64.6%/63.6%** (6 classes, 2,850 **CarDD** images); **panel match accuracy 94.2%**; **cost estimator median absolute percentage error 4.8%**; **triage sensitivity/specificity 95.0%/92.3%**;
